notes: Sample rubric. Notebook criteria are graded from the .ipynb; video criteria from the walkthrough; 'both' compares the two.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Handles missing values, types and outliers, and explains each choice in markdown.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Handles missing values and types; little justification for the choices.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Cleaning is partial or applied without checking its effect.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No cleaning step.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Summary stats plus at least three labeled charts, each followed by a written takeaway.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Relevant charts and stats, but takeaways are thin or missing for some.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Few or unlabeled charts; no interpretation.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No exploratory analysis.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Train/test split, fitted regression, R² and RMSE reported, residuals checked, results interpreted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Model fitted and evaluated with at least one metric; interpretation is brief.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Model fitted without a proper split or evaluation.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No model.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Runs top to bottom without errors; clear names, sections and comments.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Runs with minor issues; mostly readable.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Errors or out-of-order cells; hard to follow.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: Does not run.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Explains why each major step was done and what the results mean, not only what the code does.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Explains most steps; some reasoning is skipped or vague.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Mostly reads the code aloud with little reasoning.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No explanation of reasoning.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Organized, audible, within the time limit, notebook clearly visible.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.description: Generally clear; minor pacing or visibility issues.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Hard to follow, inaudible in parts, or far over/under time.

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No usable video.

levels.label: Consistent
levels.description: The notebook on screen is the submitted one and the student explains its specific code and results.

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Mostly matches, but some submitted cells are skipped or explained generically.

levels.label: Mismatch
levels.description: Video shows a different notebook or cannot explain the submitted work.
